domain: Exactly the 96 inherited cylinder failures pinned in inputs.json, plus nominal, zero-pressure and equal-pressure controls. Retained results selected after the prior completed study; no held-out claim or new independent problems.
convention: Linear isotropic pressure-only cylinder, sigma_z=0 and free axial strain; no end-cap resultant, body force, rotation or geometric nonlinearity. Original inch/psi units and declared observables preserved.
scales: S_u=a*max(pi,po)/E and S_stress=max(pi,po). Energy scale a^2*P^2/E; integral-equilibrium scale a*P. Zero load requires exact zero outputs and balances.

new_resolution_gate.estimate: D_N=max_j abs(y_N-y_(N/2))/S_j. Order=log2(D_(N/2)/D_N). Conditional finest error estimate=2*D_N/15 for fourth-order RK4, with safety factor two. Not a certified bound.
new_resolution_gate.roundoff_floor: 128*binary64_epsilon*max(1,max_j abs(y_N/S_j)); both last differences must lie below this floor for a roundoff-limited control instead of a claimed order. Floor must also fit the allocation.
new_resolution_gate.balances: Absolute Simpson integral-equilibrium and energy/work residuals, traction errors, and twice the Simpson versus subsampled-Simpson difference/15 must each fit one quarter of the unchanged characteristic budget.
new_resolution_gate.truth_audit: Only after resolution selection, compare every selected numerical claim to the separate exact rational closed form with the original full budget. A mismatch fails qualification; no truth-based resolution retuning. Original 32/64/128 gate outcomes remain untouched.

conditioning: Record dimensionless fundamental-matrix infinity-norm condition number, shooting boundary sensitivity and normalized cancellation. Diagnose floating arithmetic with separate 50-digit dimensionless Decimal RK4 at 32 steps for the prior first and worst failures and nominal control. Decimal uses the same numerical equations, not a new independent physical reference.
stopping: Measure pilot first; then process remaining inputs once, reuse completed pilot entries, checkpoint each input. Stop each specimen at first convergence-qualified resolution or max level. Preserve failures and exception details. Stop whole campaign at resource caps and leave next-index checkpoint.
exposure: Public development only. No bending/wall reruns, new faults, policy baselines, humans, host work or reserved outcomes. No physical validation or admission inferred.
